subject.title: fix: surface non-deliverable terminal turn as outbound error payload to channel plugins

question: Should `non_deliverable_terminal_turn` bypass `message_tool_only` suppression as a narrow core fallback, or should OpenClaw expose a plugin-owned terminal-failure hook instead?
rationale: Both choices change user-visible channel delivery semantics, and the linked canonical issue is explicitly labeled as needing maintainer/product direction before this contract changes.

options.title: Approve a narrow core fallback
options.body: Core sends one sanitized fallback only for confirmed non-deliverable terminal turns, after the branch is rebased and real SDK-channel proof is supplied.

options.title: Use a plugin SDK terminal hook
options.body: OpenClaw adds a documented callback so channel plugins own fallback delivery, accepting public API surface and per-plugin adoption work.

options.title: Keep message-tool-only strict
options.body: OpenClaw rejects automatic fallback delivery in this mode and leaves visible recovery to plugin-owned paths or the broader delivery-contract issue.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow core fallback
recommendation.body: Core sends one sanitized fallback only for confirmed non-deliverable terminal turns, after the branch is rebased and real SDK-channel proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest recent history on the auto-reply and follow-up delivery files whose contract would change.
